about.body:
TradeLite Trading Platform Hub

A comprehensive trading platform featuring:
• Real-time cryptocurrency trading with Binance integration
• Traditional stock market analysis tools
• Educational trading simulation
• Recovery tools for Bitcoin data

Version: 2.0
Built with modern web technologies for optimal performance.

⚠️ This is a demo application for educational purposes only.
Not intended for actual financial trading or investment advice.
